messages.subject: Meridian - Contract v3 (our turn)
messages.plaintextBody:
Amelia,

Our v3 attached (redline). We've accepted your price, retention and longstop changes. Our only points: the limitation thresholds at clause 14 lifted to £15,000 (de minimis) and £50,000 (basket), and the overage period reduced from five years to four. These are sensible for a deal of this size - hopefully uncontroversial. If agreed we can move to engrossment.

James

--
